svg.title: How atlite works: weather data, cutout, conversion, aggregation
svg.desc: 1. Weather data: reanalysis and satellite data, global or regional, such as ERA5, SARAH, GloFAS and GEBCO. 2. Cutout: a region and period, cut out as a grid of weather time series and stored in one NetCDF file. 3. Conversion: models turn the weather in each grid cell into wind, solar, hydro, heat and line rating time series, using technology data such as turbine power curves. 4. Aggregation: grid cells are summed per region or bus, weighted by overlap and installed capacity.
